content: तर, तरण, तरणि, तरण्ड, तरि-री, तरीष <ab>&c.</ab>¦ See under तॄ.

तरण्डः, -ण्डा, -ण्डी, -ण्डम् [तॄ-अण्डच्] A boat. .{@-ण्डः, -ण्डम्@} .²1 A raft or float made of bamboos tied together and floated on jars or inverted hollow gourds. .²2 The float of a fishing-line. .²3 An oar.
